dialogue.content: こんばんは相談員です。本日はよろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Good evening, I'm the counselor. It's a pleasure to speak with you today.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Thank you. It's a pleasure to speak with you too.

dialogue.content: 本日はどういったご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.English: What can I help you with today?

dialogue.content: 仕事を辞めようか迷っています
dialogue.English: I'm thinking about quitting my job.

dialogue.content: それは大変悩ましいですよね。。
dialogue.English: That's a very difficult decision to be facing, isn't it?

dialogue.content: はい…
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: どうしてやめようと思われたのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: What has led you to consider leaving?

dialogue.content: やりがいを感じられず給料も低いからです
dialogue.English: I don't find it rewarding, and the pay is low.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。それは辛いですよね。。
dialogue.English: I see. That must be difficult for you.

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes, it is.

dialogue.content: どんなお仕事をされていますか？
dialogue.English: What kind of work do you do?

dialogue.content: 栄養士です。
dialogue.English: I'm a dietitian.

dialogue.content: 人の生活に欠かせない、大事なお仕事ですよね。
dialogue.English: That's such an important job, essential to people's lives.

dialogue.content: そうですね…
dialogue.English: I suppose so...

dialogue.content: 普段どんな風にお仕事されているのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: What does your day-to-day work look like?

dialogue.content: 給食センターで、調理しています。
dialogue.English: I cook at a school lunch center.

dialogue.content: ずっと調理です。
dialogue.English: It's been nothing but cooking.

dialogue.content: 調理のお仕事がずっと続いて、しんどい感じでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Has the continuous cooking work been wearing you down?

dialogue.content: 栄養士なのに、調理ばっかりで、それらしいことをほとんどしていません。
dialogue.English: Even though I'm a dietitian, all I do is cook. I hardly do anything a dietitian is supposed to do.

dialogue.content: 何のために学校を出たのか…
dialogue.English: I wonder what the point of going to school for this was...

dialogue.content: 情けないです
dialogue.English: I feel so pathetic.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。本来の仕事が出来ないのは嫌になりますよね。。
dialogue.English: I understand. It must be frustrating not being able to do the work you trained for.

dialogue.content: はい。もう嫌になります
dialogue.English: Yes. I'm really fed up with it.

dialogue.content: 職場は何人くらいで働いているのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: About how many people are on your team at work?

dialogue.content: 10人くらいです
dialogue.English: About 10 people.

dialogue.content: 職場の雰囲気とかはどんな感じでしょうか？
dialogue.English: What's the atmosphere like at work?

dialogue.content: ベテランのおばちゃんが威張っていて、新人は立つ瀬がありません…
dialogue.English: The veteran ladies are bossy, and newcomers don't stand a chance...

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。それはやりづらいですよね。。
dialogue.English: I see. That must make it difficult to work there.

dialogue.content: はい…
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: 先ほど　せっかく学校出たのに…ということでしたが、もう少し違う形の仕事を希望しておられたのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: You mentioned earlier that you went to school for this... were you hoping for a different kind of role?

dialogue.content: 栄養士らしく、献立を作ったり指導したりして食べる人の役に立ちたかったです。
dialogue.English: I wanted to do the work of a dietitian—creating menus, providing guidance, and helping the people who eat the food.

dialogue.content: 栄養士らしい仕事が出来ないのは、苦しいですよね。。
dialogue.English: It must be painful not being able to do the work of a dietitian.

dialogue.content: はい。学んだことが活かされず、辛いです。
dialogue.English: Yes. It's hard when I can't apply what I've learned.

dialogue.content: そうですよね、落ち込みますよね。。
dialogue.English: Yes, that would make anyone feel down.

dialogue.content: 何のために働いているのか…
dialogue.English: What am I even working for...

dialogue.content: 絶望です
dialogue.English: I feel hopeless.

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mmm-hmm.

dialogue.content: もう仕事にいきたくありません
dialogue.English: I don't want to go to work anymore.

dialogue.content: 苦しくて、逃げてしまいたくもなりますよね。。
dialogue.English: It's so painful, it makes you want to run away, doesn't it?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 調理の仕事はご自身の中で、どんな感じで受け止めておられますか？
dialogue.English: How do you personally feel about the cooking work?

dialogue.content: 必要な仕事だとはわかっていますが、調理員として就職したわけではないので、受け入れられません
dialogue.English: I know it's necessary work, but I wasn't hired as a cook, so I can't accept it.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。それは戸惑いますよね。。
dialogue.English: I can understand that. It must be very confusing.

dialogue.content: はい…
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: 就職の際は調理員としてではなくて、というお話だったのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: When you were hired, was the understanding that you wouldn't be working as a cook?

dialogue.content: はい。献立を考えたり、栄養士として働くということでした。
dialogue.English: Yes. I was told I would be creating menus and working as a dietitian.

dialogue.content: えー！裏切られた感じですよね
dialogue.English: Wow, that must feel like a betrayal.

dialogue.content: そうなんです……
dialogue.English: Exactly...

dialogue.content: 思ってたのと違うくて…
dialogue.English: It's not what I expected...

dialogue.content: 献立を考えたりという話が、どうして調理員に。。。理由とかはお聞きになりましたか？
dialogue.English: How did the conversation about planning menus turn into you being a cook? Did they give you a reason?

dialogue.content: なんか人手が足りないみたいで…実際のその仕事は管理栄養士さんがやってます…
dialogue.English: Apparently, they're short-staffed... A registered dietitian is doing that work...

dialogue.content: 自分の出る幕ないみたいで…
dialogue.English: It feels like there's no room for me...

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、、それは困りますよね。。
dialogue.English: I see... That puts you in a difficult position, doesn't it?

dialogue.content: 悲しいです
dialogue.English: It makes me sad.

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mmm-hmm.

dialogue.content: なんでこんな仕事してるんでしょうか…
dialogue.English: Why am I even doing this job...?

dialogue.content: とても落ち込んで、苦しくなりますよね。。
dialogue.English: It's very disheartening and painful, isn't it?

dialogue.content: はい、落ち込んでます…
dialogue.English: Yes, I'm feeling down...

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mmm-hmm.

dialogue.content: 会社側からはそのことについて、それ以上の説明はないのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Has the company provided any further explanation about this?

dialogue.content: 管理栄養士の見習いという感じらしいですが、調理が忙しく直接指導を受けたりもできませんし…曖昧な感じにされてます
dialogue.English: It's supposedly an apprenticeship under the registered dietitian, but cooking is so busy that I can't get any direct guidance... It's all kept very vague.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。それはがっかりしますよね。。
dialogue.English: I see. That must be disappointing.

dialogue.content: はい…自分の立場がわかりません
dialogue.English: Yes... I don't know where I stand.

dialogue.content: 仕事に専念することもできません
dialogue.English: I can't even focus on my work.

dialogue.content: そうですよね、、気になって仕事にも集中できなくなりますよね。。
dialogue.English: Right... It's hard to concentrate when something like that is weighing on you.

dialogue.content: 今の会社はどれくらいの期間働いておられますか？
dialogue.English: How long have you been working at your current company?

dialogue.content: いつか栄養士の仕事が出来るのか、ずっと調理をするのかもわからず、先のことを決められません
dialogue.English: I don't know if I'll ever get to do a dietitian's work or if I'll be cooking forever, so I can't make any plans for the future.

dialogue.content: 1年です
dialogue.English: One year.

dialogue.content: すみません、質問がかぶってしまいました。先が見通せず暗い気持ちになりますよね。。
dialogue.English: I'm sorry, my question overlapped with what you were saying. It must feel bleak not being able to see a path forward.

dialogue.content: はい…もう見切りをつけるべきなのか…
dialogue.English: Yes... I'm wondering if I should just cut my losses...

dialogue.content: でも1年で辞めるのか…とか考えちゃいます
dialogue.English: But then I start thinking... quitting after only a year...?

dialogue.content: うんうんもう辞めてしまおうかというくらい。。追いつめらているのですね。。
dialogue.English: Mmm-hmm. You're feeling so cornered that you're thinking of just quitting.

dialogue.content: そんな感じです…
dialogue.English: That's how it feels...

dialogue.content: このことを誰かに相談したことはありますか？
dialogue.English: Have you talked to anyone about this?

dialogue.content: ううん…しにくいですね…
dialogue.English: No... it's hard to bring up.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。。大切な問題ですから相談しにくいですよね。。
dialogue.English: I understand. It's an important issue, so it can be hard to discuss.

dialogue.content: 就職する前からそういった話は聞いていましたが、まさか自分の身に起こるとは思わなくて。
dialogue.English: I had heard stories like this before I started working, but I never thought it would happen to me.

dialogue.content: ちょっと恥ずかしい感じです
dialogue.English: It feels a bit embarrassing.

dialogue.content: こんなの辛すぎますよね。。
dialogue.English: That's just too painful to go through.

dialogue.content: はい…それ見たことかって言われそうで…
dialogue.English: Yes... I'm afraid people will say, "I told you so."

dialogue.content: 誰かに言われそうで、怖い感じでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Are you afraid someone might say that to you?

dialogue.content: はい…考え無しって思われそうで…
dialogue.English: Yes... I'm afraid they'll think I didn't think it through.

dialogue.content: うんうん
dialogue.English: Mmm-hmm.

dialogue.content: そんな風に言わるのは、とても悔しいですよね。。
dialogue.English: It would be very frustrating to be told something like that, wouldn't it?

dialogue.content: はい。悔しいです
dialogue.English: Yes, it is frustrating.

dialogue.content: でも、よく考えなかった自分も浅はかだったのかなって…思ったりもします
dialogue.English: But I also wonder if I was naive for not thinking it through more carefully.

dialogue.content: 肩身が狭くなる感じがしてるのですね。。
dialogue.English: It sounds like you're feeling self-conscious.

dialogue.content: ここで、
dialogue.English: At this point,

dialogue.content: 少しこれまでのお話を整理させていただいてよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: may I summarize what we've discussed so far?

dialogue.content: 大丈夫です
dialogue.English: Yes, that's fine.

dialogue.content: 有難うございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 調理員として就職したわけではないのに、調理員として働かされ、仕事を辞めようか迷っておられます
dialogue.English: You weren't hired to be a cook, yet you're being made to work as one, and now you're considering quitting your job.

dialogue.content: 本来は献立を作ったり指導したりしたかったが、人手不足でその仕事は管理栄養士がしている状況です
dialogue.English: You originally wanted to create menus and provide guidance, but due to a staff shortage, that work is currently being handled by a registered dietitian.

dialogue.content: 会社の説明と違うのは許せないし、もう絶望も感じられ仕事にも行きたくない
dialogue.English: You feel betrayed that the reality is different from what the company explained, and you're feeling hopeless to the point you don't want to go to work anymore.

dialogue.content: 今の状況はとても受け入れられるものではなく、先の見通しも立たない状況で、もう会社を辞めたいと思い詰めておられる
dialogue.English: The current situation is unacceptable to you, you can't see a future there, and you're feeling pushed to the point of wanting to quit.

dialogue.content: このようなお話と思いますが、いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Does that sound about right, based on our conversation?

dialogue.content: はい、そうです
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: 有難うございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 少し、私が感じたことをお伝えさえてもらってもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Would it be all right if I shared a few of my impressions?

dialogue.content: はい、お願いします
dialogue.English: Yes, please.

dialogue.content: 今、やむなく調理のお仕事をさせてられていますが、栄養士の本来のお仕事をやりたいという熱意は衰えることなく、ずっと持ち続けておられます
dialogue.English: Right now, you're being forced to do this cooking work, but your passion to do the real work of a dietitian hasn't faded at all; you've held onto it this whole time.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: もっともっと人の役に立ちたい！という熱い情熱をお持ちの方だと感じました
dialogue.English: I get the sense that you are someone with a strong passion to help people more and more.

dialogue.content: そうですね…
dialogue.English: I suppose so...

dialogue.content: ここまで人のことを考えられる栄養士さんは本当に素晴らしいと思いました
dialogue.English: I think a dietitian who cares so much about people is truly wonderful.

dialogue.content: 一方で、その情熱とは反対の調理員という現状は受け入れられないでおられます
dialogue.English: On the other hand, you find it unacceptable that your current reality as a cook is the opposite of that passion.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: これは　それだけ人の役に立ちたい情熱が強いからこそだと感じました
dialogue.English: I feel that this is precisely because your passion to help people is so strong.

dialogue.content: そこでご提案なのですが、
dialogue.English: With that in mind, may I offer a suggestion?

dialogue.content: まがりなりにも、センター側は今は見習い期間と言っているとのことでした
dialogue.English: You mentioned that the center, for what it's worth, is calling this an apprenticeship period.

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そうであれば、自分の中で今は見習い期間と位置付けて、現場経験を積める時期ととらえてみるというのはいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: If that's the case, how about reframing this for yourself as an apprenticeship period—an opportunity to gain hands-on experience?

dialogue.content: そして
dialogue.English: And then,

dialogue.content: 自分の中で期間を区切ってやってみる。例えばあと半年とか。
dialogue.English: set a time limit for yourself. For example, another six months.

dialogue.content: そして
dialogue.English: And then,

dialogue.content: その期間を過ぎてもセンター側から何も動きが無ければ、いい経験をさせてもらったということで、次のステップへ踏み出す　というのはいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: if after that period there's still no change on the center's side, you could see it as having gained good experience and then take the next step forward. How does that sound?

dialogue.content: そうですね。期間を区切るのはいいかもしれません。会社にももう一度この状況について聞いてみます。
dialogue.English: That makes sense. Setting a time frame might be a good idea. I'll also ask the company about this situation again.

dialogue.content: そうです。私も会社にそのことを聞くのはいいかと思います
dialogue.English: Yes, I agree that asking the company about it is a good idea.

dialogue.content: その回答の上で、身の振り方を考えようと思います
dialogue.English: Based on their response, I'll think about how to move forward.

dialogue.content: きっと、こんなに意識の高い情熱のある栄養士さんで、さらに調理の現場経験を踏んでいれば次のステップも大丈夫だと思いました
dialogue.English: I'm confident that for a dietitian as conscientious and passionate as you are—especially with hands-on cooking experience—you'll be well-positioned for your next step.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 有難うございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: もっと調理も上手くなって、役に立つ栄養士になります
dialogue.English: I'll get better at cooking and become an even more helpful dietitian.

dialogue.content: そうです。あなたの情熱が、どんどん押し上げてくれると思いますよ！
dialogue.English: Exactly. I believe your passion will continue to propel you forward!

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you.

dialogue.content: 有難うございました
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: 夢に向かって、よりよい働き方を見つけられるよう応援しております！
dialogue.English: I'll be rooting for you to find a better way of working toward your dream!

dialogue.content: 前向きな気持ちになれましたありがとうございました
dialogue.English: I feel much more positive now. Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: 本日はご相談に来ていただきどうも有難うございました
dialogue.English: Thank you so much for coming in for a consultation today.

dialogue.content: また何かありましたら、ぜひまたお越しください
dialogue.English: If anything else comes up, please don't hesitate to come back.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: それでは失礼いたします
dialogue.English: Well then, take care.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.
